g.text: memtable-bench | Xeon Gold 6240 | 1M stored versions | 33 B logical key + 64 B value
5 runs: median and Q1-Q3; NUMA node 0, physical CPUs 2-17; shared server, Turbo enabled.
ART/HOT store 67 B nibble keys; codec and synchronization costs included. Dashed curves: coarse RW lock.
Scans validate order/checksum; no SSTable compression or disk I/O. RSS is an allocation/allocator estimate.
